reason: The primary specification names several descriptive constructs but leaves deterministic tie-breaks and state thresholds implicit. These definitions are frozen before calculating those outcomes.

realized_episode_leader.eligible_stocks: Stocks with at least one closed limit-up assigned to the exact raw primary_theme between episode_start and episode_end inclusive.
realized_episode_leader.peak_return_tiebreak: Maximum compounded tbl_cn_day pct_chg path from episode_start through any episode trading date, with missing stock dates treated as flat zero and baseline equity 1.
remaining_tiebreaks: date maximum board_count was first attained ascending
earliest valid limit-up time on that attainment date ascending
realized_episode_leader.label: hindsight descriptive; never substituted for frozen initial roles

daily_realized_leader.eligible_stocks: Closed limit-ups assigned to the exact raw primary_theme on an active episode date.
order: valid limit-up time ascending with missing last
daily_realized_leader.within_episode_switch: Daily realized leader ts_code changes between consecutive active dates of the same episode.
daily_realized_leader.after_fade_switch: Hindsight realized episode leader differs between consecutive episodes of the same raw primary_theme.

capacity_core.schema_mapping: Use SPEC_AMENDMENT_SCHEMA_20260921.json: primary_theme equals tbl_cn_kpl_concept_cons.name; member code/name are con_code/con_name.
capacity_core.membership: Freeze exact concept membership on role_freeze_date and carry that same member set through the episode; never use later membership snapshots.
capacity_core.universe_filter: SH/SZ member codes only; exclude member names beginning ST or *ST on the freeze snapshot.
capacity_core.percentile: Deterministic ascending average-tie rank divided by n; one member receives 1.0.
capacity_core.candidate_filter: circ_mv percentile >=0.80 and amount percentile >=0.70 on role_freeze_date, with non-missing pct_chg.
capacity_core.clear_core: At least one candidate passes the filter; retain top one as primary and second as runner-up when present.
capacity_core.theme_return: Equal-weight daily pct_chg across the frozen eligible SH/SZ membership with available returns; expose daily member denominator.
capacity_core.relative_return: Core daily pct_chg minus theme equal-weight pct_chg, in percentage points.
capacity_core.rolling3_relative: Three-trading-day compounded core return minus compounded theme equal-weight return, in percentage points; use available episode days and flag windows shorter than three.
state_precedence: weak if rolling3_relative <= -2.0pp, or daily_relative <= -1.0pp and rolling3_relative < 0
strong if rolling3_relative >= +2.0pp, or daily_relative >= +1.0pp and rolling3_relative > 0
capacity_core.episode_recurrence_outcome: Whether the same raw primary_theme has a later episode after the current episode.
continuation_outcomes_next_trading_day: frozen Leader1 is a closed limit-up assigned to the same raw theme
capacity_core.weak_signal_lag: Trading-day distance from first primary-core weak state to episode_end; blank when no weak state.

unchanged: capacity score weights and candidate percentile cutoffs
